roles.heroLead: Waterproof isn't a property of tile — it's a property of the membrane bonded behind it. On Whidbey, where a redo means re-ordering materials across the water, we get it right once: full assembly built, a 24-hour flood test held and photographed, and only then does tile leave the box.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Oak Harbor, WA?
roles.costP1: Oak Harbor tile installation prices at roughly $14–$26 per square foot installed — that's the tile, setting materials, substrate preparation and labor together, labor starting at $11/sq ft on its own. A tub-shower surround runs $3,200–$6,800, a bathroom floor around 45 sq ft runs $900–$1,600, and a full bathroom with shower, floor and niche lands at $6,500–$14,000.
roles.costP2: One planning note worth knowing early: format sets the labor. A $4 mosaic sheet can carry a bigger install bill than a $12 large-format porcelain plank, because the crew's hours track cuts and grout joints — not what the tile cost per box.
roles.costNote: Oak Harbor ranges, accurate to August 2026, combining tile, materials and labor. Your free estimate closes with the real number in writing.
roles.layersLead: Seven layers sit between subfloor and grout, and each failed shower we're called to open skipped one of them — the membrane more often than not, cut to save a few hundred dollars and destined to cost five figures at demo.
roles.whyP1: Shower leaks run on a delay. Water clears the grout, loads the substrate, and the first visible sign — a soft hallway floor, a ceiling stain below — arrives a couple of years later. The scope by then isn't tile; it's framing, subfloor, drywall and a complete re-tile.
roles.whyP2: Waterproofing claims about a tenth of a shower's budget. There is no more expensive money saved in remodeling.

roles.faqH2: Tile installation FAQ — Oak Harbor, WA
roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Oak Harbor, WA?
roles.faqA1: Count on $14 to $26 per square foot installed for Oak Harbor tile work — the tile, setting materials, substrate preparation and labor included, labor itself starting at $11 per square foot. Standard tub-shower surrounds price at $3,200 to $6,800; a complete bathroom holding floor, shower and niche typically totals $6,500 to $14,000. Format drives the labor more than tile price does — mosaic sheets and large-format planks both take far more time per square foot than 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Oak Harbor?
roles.faqA2: A standard alcove shower in Oak Harbor runs $3,200 to $6,800 all-in: the tear-out, bonded waterproofing, a sloped base or pan, the tile setting, niche and grout. Steam showers, benches, curbless entries and full-height stone push higher. Waterproofing is roughly a tenth of the invoice — and the reason you never meet the five-figure repair.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Yes, on every shower, without exception. The system behind our tile is bonded waterproofing, not bare cement board and thinset: a sloped base, a sheet or liquid membrane rated to ANSI A118.10 taken up the walls, sealed corners, seams and penetrations, then a 24-hour flood test that gets photographed before the first tile is set. Tile and grout shed water; the membrane is what keeps it out of the framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Four to six working days is the honest schedule for an Oak Harbor bathroom: demolition and dust protection, substrate plus waterproofing with its 24-hour flood test, one to two days setting tile, then grout, silicone and trim. Add 24 hours of grout cure before first use. A floor alone takes a day or two. If you're working around a move, deployment or PCS date, say so — the schedule goes in writing.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain wherever there's water or traffic: it absorbs less than 0.5% water, resists chipping and handles wear — the right call in Oak Harbor's damp island climate. Ceramic is a sound, cheaper choice for walls and backsplashes. Our spec runs porcelain on every floor and shower floor, with ceramic or glass earning wall duty.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes. An electric radiant mat under tile runs $11–$16 per square foot installed, with its thermostat in that price. It installs over an uncoupling membrane, is resistance-tested at the start and the end of setting, and runs on a dedicated circuit. The scheduling truth: it's only worth adding while the floor is open, so we fold it into the plan from day one rather than revisiting later.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: In most cases, yes. Demo with haul-away starts at $3.50 per square foot and is the only true look at your subfloor — rot, movement and door-threshold heights all get checked then. Tiling over existing tile is workable on a sound, flat and firmly bonded base, though it raises finished height and buries whatever we'd rather have found at demolition.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Oak Harbor?
roles.faqA8: An Oak Harbor kitchen backsplash installs for $1,100 to $2,200 at the typical 30 square feet — outlets cut in, edges finished, grout matched to your counter. The top of that range belongs to mosaic sheets, herringbone, picture-frame details behind the range and full-height slab-look porcelain: layout and cutting time set the price.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Often. Repair and regrout starts at $8 per square foot and fits when grout is stained or crumbling, a tile or two cracked from impact, or shower corners need their grout removed and re-done in silicone. When tile sounds hollow, loosens in a pattern or the wall has gone soft, the substrate has failed and repair only postpones demo. We diagnose which you have — and put it in writing — before quoting.
roles.faqQ10: Which Oak Harbor neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: All of Oak Harbor and North Whidbey — Old Town, Scenic Heights, Swantown, Fort Nugent, Crescent Harbor, Maylor Point, Clover Valley, Dugualla Bay, Strawberry Point, Polnell Point and West Beach — plus Penn Cove Park, San de Fuca, Coupeville and Cornet Bay, and across the bridge to Anacortes.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Tile installation carries OC Flooring's 2-year workmanship warranty — intentionally longer than our carpet warranty, because tile problems surface in year two rather than week two. When the full bonded waterproofing assembly comes from one manufacturer, their warranty adds to ours. Membrane and flood test photos go in your records, useful at resale or for a housing office file.
